title: Output has zero fanout after conversion
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs whose gates each have distinct arguments and exactly one argument for a NOT gate or two for an AND or OR gate. In the circuit obtained by the bounded-fanout conversion, the output vertex has fanout zero.
hypotheses_covered: Every gate of $C$ has distinct arguments and the prescribed arity
